name: Improper Input Validation
provenance: Written from the CWE-20 definition. CWE-20 is a parent weakness with no characteristic sink: this rule is intentionally BROAD (untrusted input reaches a sensitive operation inside a unit with no validation / authorization vocabulary). Expect low precision and weak recall; it is a baseline for the class, not a detector.
notes: S1 = unit reads untrusted input (or is a request handler) AND performs a sensitive operation. S2 = S1 and no validation/authorization vocabulary in the unit and not every in-slice caller chain is guarded (PHP pred semantics).
